description: This file defines the `IdentityStoreClient` class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS SSO Identity Store service. It primarily contains method declarations (via PHP docblock annotations) for various identity store operations such as creating, deleting, describing, listing, and updating groups and users.

classes.name: IdentityStoreClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS SSO Identity Store service, extending the general AWS client infrastructure.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group in the identity store.

methods.name: createGroupMembership
methods.description: Creates a new membership linking a user to a group.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the identity store.

methods.name: describeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific group.

methods.name: describeGroupMembership
methods.description: Retrieves details about a group membership.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a group based on some criteria.

methods.name: getGroupMembershipId
methods.description: Gets the ID of a group membership.

methods.name: getGroupMembershipIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the group membership ID.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a user.

methods.name: isMemberInGroups
methods.description: Checks if a user is a member of specific groups.

methods.name: listGroupMembershipsForMember
methods.description: Lists group memberships for a specific member.

methods.name: listGroupMembershipsForMemberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists group memberships for a member.

methods.name: updateGroup
methods.description: Updates details of an existing group.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates details of an existing user.
